whatsappMessage:
Hi Kiran Toys Team,

I noticed your toy shop has exceptional 4.9★ reviews across 700+ happy parents in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile catalog for instant toy enquiries and festive gifting.

Maine aapke store ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp toy inquiry, age-wise categories, aur store timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/kirantoys

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Kiran Toys Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp toy inquiry and mobile-first speed for parents searching along West Boring Canal Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual product photos aur categories integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
